stances_toward.note: Puntland withdrew its recognition of the federal government in March-April 2024 over the constitutional amendments and has run its own affairs since. Its president Deni belongs to the opposition that rejects the extension of Hassan Sheikh's term (Somali Future Council, May 2026); Puntland stayed out of the Turkish-brokered talks of 7-8 Jul 2026, questioning Ankara's neutrality, and rejected Mogadishu's annulment of the UAE agreements, keeping its UAE security cooperation and the 30-year DP World concession at Bosaso (Jan 2026), a port Mogadishu in turn offered to Washington in its letter of March 2025. Graded rival and not claimed_territory, following the Bosnia review of 12 Oct 2026: territorial grades belong to territories, and the actor graded is the Garowe administration, which competes with the state while the land stays a federal member state of Somalia in Mogadishu's reading. Cooling with each step of the centralising programme. Bond kin: one Somali nation and clan system, which makes this a feud in the ledger's terms. The Puntland-side reading was not found, so the reciprocal stance generated by the build is provisional.

relations_to.summary: Bring Puntland back under the federal constitutional order after it withdrew its recognition of the federal government in March-April 2024. Mogadishu's levers are the amended constitution and the electoral law and mediated talks (Halane in May 2026, Turkish-brokered talks of 7-8 Jul 2026), none of which has produced an agreement: Puntland sent no delegates in July and questioned Ankara's neutrality.
